दामोदर son of Candrapati, brother of Megha Bhagīratha

दामोदर son of Lāla, father of Balabhadra (Hāyanaratna)
and Harirāma. W. p. 264.

दामोदर son of Rāghavadeva, father of Lakṣmīdhara,
Kṛṣṇa, and Śārṅgadhara (Paddhati). Oxf. 122^b. 315^a.

दामोदर a medical author. Quoted Oxf. 321^a.

namayūkha.
